title: Polygon Map Generator (MIT iQuHack)

Built at MIT iQuHack, a quantum computing hackathon: a procedural map generator that uses quantum circuits in Qiskit as a true random source to seed Voronoi polygon regions, producing unique terrain and borders on every run.
